checks.proofCoverage: Per-result semantic correspondence and final critical proof paths reviewed; every current source checked strictly. Not an independent handwritten rederivation of every tactic or a full program audit.

findings.title: The documented proof-check loop returns success after a compiler failure
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Correct the advertised automated verification command before publication acceptance.
findings.affected: EasyCrypt README.md:118; applies to both documented toolchains.
findings.reproduction: Replace easycrypt by a shell function returning 7 and run the exact README loop over two synthetic filenames.
findings.expected: The first failed proof stops checking and propagates a nonzero exit status.
findings.observed: The loop prints FAILED: First.ec, skips Second.ec and exits 0. A version using exit 1 exits 1.
findings.impact: Automation can accept an incomplete or failed proof run. This does not make the current checked proofs false.
findings.evidence: Local static-inventory.json/readmeLoop; static.log; independent publication challenge.
findings.recommendedFix: Ship a verifier that exits nonzero on a failed compile, preserves the failing filename and compiles every source strictly.
findings.requiredVerification: Stub failure must produce a nonzero verifier status; successful checking must cover all 18 sources. Keep this separate from the positive proof run.

findings.title: The no-cache checking recipe can accept an unchanged false theorem from a weak cache
findings.releaseBlockingReason: The advertised fresh-source proof check must refuse or independently exclude existing root caches.
findings.affected: EasyCrypt README.md:114-118; installed EasyCrypt ce19cb6 src/ec.ml:660-664,936 and src/ecEco.ml:225-273.
findings.reproduction: On an isolated false synthetic theorem, create a cache with compile -pragmas Proofs:weak; run the documented compile -no-eco unchanged; deactivate only that synthetic cache and repeat.
findings.expected: A strict fresh-source check rejects the false theorem regardless of an existing weak-check cache.
findings.observed: Weak creation exits 0; strict -no-eco replay exits 0 with an empty log; the same source without its active cache exits 1 with cannot prove goal (strict).
findings.impact: The recipe can skip actual proof checking and reuse results not established strictly. Current audited src has no .eco, and its fresh positive runs remain valid.
findings.evidence: Local cache-create-weak, cache-strict-replay and cache-without-cache command/log records; synthetic source/cache retained locally; independent source and digest challenge.
findings.recommendedFix: Refuse existing root .eco files before a claimed fresh check, or document a verified safe cache-isolation procedure. Do not delete user caches silently. The audit harness now refuses cached roots.
findings.requiredVerification: The synthetic weak-cache case must be refused before acceptance; a cache-free false theorem must fail; all current cache-free sources must pass.

findings.title: The broad result-index claim obscures exact forms that are not formalized
findings.affected: EasyCrypt README.md:38-39 and INDEX.md introduction; compare DESIGN.md:254-259 and Theorem5.ec:1303,1408.
findings.reproduction: Compare the exact uniform-top2 identity and adaptive expectation bound in current supplement A.6 with the named EasyCrypt signatures.
findings.expected: A claim that every result is indexed distinguishes exact statements from weaker consequences and informal lifts.
findings.observed: top2_uniform proves only an upper inequality; theorem5_cost uses a constant pointwise envelope. The new capped-failure lift has no encoded public game/theorem.
findings.impact: Readers can infer sentence-by-sentence formal coverage that the source does not establish. No proved inequality is contradicted.
findings.evidence: Independent W-family review and skeptical challenge; exact signatures reproduced in this report.
findings.recommendedFix: Qualify complete-coverage wording and list exactness limits prominently, or add the missing exact forms. Keep the already disclosed finite-passphrase qualification.
findings.requiredVerification: Each claimed exact assertion must point to a signature with matching quantifiers, event and formula; the table must mark weaker/narrower variants explicitly.

findings.title: Unqualified independence wording can imply blind independence of statements
findings.reproduction: Read the public-facing independently wording against the explicit prior review of Lean statements in SCOPE and the comparison limitations.
findings.expected: Describe separate proof systems without implying independently derived blind statements.
findings.observed: The README says independently, while retained provenance explicitly says the EasyCrypt author had read the Lean statements first.
findings.impact: The wording can overstate the independence evidence. This review found no basis to allege copied proofs or invalid verification.
findings.evidence: Independent publication challenge; cited documents and their retained hashes.
findings.recommendedFix: Say separately implemented in two proof systems and disclose prior access to the Lean statements in the same paragraph.
findings.requiredVerification: The introduction and comparison limitations must give a consistent provenance account.
